name: Seesaw Market Lab
one_liner: Use frozen paper-market hypotheses as the fastest numerical laboratory for Seesaw causal discovery.
core_thesis: Liquid markets provide frequent, external, quantitative resolution of Seesaw claims. The lab pre-registers causal chains, horizons and falsifiers, then resolves them mechanically. Paper results validate causal forecasting only; live execution alpha remains a separate claim.
why_now: The system needs a fast external feedback world for selecting and calibrating causal procedures.
job: Learn which Seesaw constraint mappings predict external price/economic outcomes without risking capital.
distribution: Internal; outputs can later inform asset campaigns and trading research.
moat: Not a standalone moat. Value is the proprietary longitudinal corpus of frozen hypotheses, failures, calibration and learned procedures.
falsifiers: Pre-registered Seesaw predictions do not outperform simple baselines after sufficient sample size.
The signal is too slow/noisy to improve campaign allocation.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI ships perfect market-reasoning and backtesting software tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: Software can be copied; the frozen longitudinal hypothesis/outcome corpus and learned calibration are historical trajectory data.

underengineer.scarce_state_target: A growing corpus of pre-registered Seesaw hypotheses resolved against external markets.
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Freeze one Seesaw thesis, open a zero-capital paper position, define benchmark/horizon/falsifier, resolve it from external data, and append one immutable scored row.

steps.action: Freeze one causal market hypothesis and resolution rule
steps.acceptance: Timestamped thesis contains causal chain, sign, horizon, benchmark and falsifier.

steps.action: Open paper position and lock decision-time snapshot
steps.acceptance: Position and snapshot are immutable before future outcome is read.
Outcome, baseline and calibration row are recorded with external evidence.

steps.action: Compare against baseline and update procedure evidence
steps.acceptance: No post-hoc thesis mutation; procedure change requires empirical support.

underengineer.graduation_rule: At least one externally resolved row exists; scale only after repeated pre-registered samples reveal useful calibration.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If repeated hypotheses fail to beat naive baselines or cannot be frozen/resolved unambiguously, revise Seesaw procedure before adding complexity.
underengineer.observation_pause: Accumulate enough independent resolutions to inspect calibration by scarcity class/horizon before changing the model.

experiment_strategy.learning_goal: Rapid external calibration of Seesaw causal claims.
